posts.title: So, What Else is New -- Or Not
posts.description: Have you seen the montages on the late night shows where local news folk are exclaiming in animated tones: "Can you BELIEVE it's fall?" "Can you BELIEVE that Halloween is next week?" "Can you BELIEVE we'll be seeing snow this week?" or similar. Lizzie just doesn't care. Continue Reading »

posts.title: A Brief Encounter at the Ditch
posts.description: Fall seems to be fading quickly here after a glorious streak of warm weather. The temps have dropped, a chill in the air, and often a damp chill, the kind that makes you long for something warm and cozy. But on voting day, the sun was out, the weather warm. posts.title: Cork Poppers Celebrate Autumn Reds
posts.description: Late in October, we had another Cork Popper gathering, this time at Kate and Mike's house. I honestly can't remember what the theme was but we knew Cheryl wouldn't be there, so all the wines ended up being reds! Rick was first with Mediterra, a Tuscan wine by Poggio al Tesoro (2016) that he bought in Canada. He paid $13.99 Canadian, which came to about $12 US. Continue Reading »
